# Bounded JSON text controls

The executable fixture is `conformance/SEM/SEM-3-json-text-bound-36-run.hir`;
its borrowed-result negative twin remains a source rejection. The driver module
adds exact four-engine observations, app full-main Fixture rows and separate
record/replay tapes with changed-binding refusal. Production-source instrumentation
counts each decoded append/capacity request before executing it, including
scalar formatting; there is no full decoded temporary or RSS-based proof.

Prior art: serde_json 8c535a260ce561eaab4111aafc29038eb9f77ff3,
`src/read.rs:521-568,925-1033`, `tests/test.rs:1099-1167` (MIT OR Apache-2.0;
see third-party/NOTICES.md). Retain strict surrogate/escape policy; intentionally
add decoded UTF-8 byte admission and scan-only overflow. Hirsel keeps its old
Syntax offsets, delayed UTF-8 precedence and owned-result contracts.
